 RHB first bank in Malaysia to offer DuitNow Pay acceptance for merchants
 TheStar 
 Thu, Nov 12, 2026 10:48am - 4 hours 
 View Original 
 KUALA LUMPUR: RHB Bank Bhd has become the first bank in Malaysia to enable merchants to accept DuitNow Pay through its RHB PAY platform.
 “RHB is also currently the only bank in Malaysia to offer both online and recurring payment acceptance through DuitNow Pay, strengthening its digital payment proposition for businesses,” the bank said in a statement.
 Operated by Payments Network Malaysia Sdn Bhd (PayNet), DuitNow Pay allows merchants to accept online payments through DuitNow Online Banking/Wallets and recurring payments through DuitNow AutoDebit.
 RHB said merchants could transition from existing FPX and DirectDebit arrangements to DuitNow Pay, with collections credited directly into their RHB accounts. 
 ...
 Summary Overview 
 • RHB Bank has become the first financial institution in Malaysia to enable merchants to accept DuitNow Pay, distinguishing itself as the only bank currently offering both online and recurring payment acceptance through this channel.
• The integration allows businesses to transition from existing FPX and DirectDebit setups to DuitNow Pay, facilitating payments via participating banks and e-wallets while ensuring collections are credited directly into RHB accounts.
• RHB PAY, launched in August 2026, consolidates card, FPX, and DuitNow Pay acceptance into a single integration with real-time settlement and automated reconciliation, reducing the need for merchants to overhaul existing collection systems.
• Executives from RHB and PayNet highlighted that this collaboration aims to accelerate digital payment adoption by simplifying integration complexity and helping merchants adapt to evolving customer preferences for online and recurring transactions.
